Greetings, Agents!

 

This is CM Fragment of MARVEL Future Fight.
 

We have prepared a patch that introduces Spectrum, successor to the name of Captain Marvel,
and improvements for the Ultimates, who handle problems with the universe and cosmic beings.

 

Download the 7/14 patch data
and grow the new Super Hero and Uniforms, and the new Tier-3 heroes!

 

[7/14 4:42 a.m. (UTC+0) / 7/13 9:42 p.m. (PDT) Added]

The patch has been completed as of 7/14 2:31 a.m. (UTC+0) / 7/13 7:31 p.m. (PDT). 

Please reconnect to the game and download the patch file.

 

■ 7/14 Patch Details
 
- Server Patch Period: 7/14 4:00 a.m. (UTC+0), 7/13 9:00 p.m. (PDT) 

* The patch will be applied in waves, so the application time may vary by Agent.
* The game can still be accessed during the patch. 
* Please restart your game and download the new patch when it is done.
 

▣ One New Hero

 

The Super Hero who succeeds the name of Captain Marvel!
Check out the powerful Blast energy of Spectrum. 

* Skills are based on the maximum stats.
* The schedule and details for the [Timed Event] Magic VS Science Faction Battle
where Agents can acquire Spectrum will be announced later.

 

 

▣ 5 New Uniforms

 

New Uniforms have been added to support the Ultimates who protect our universe.
Behold the new looks of Blue Marvel, Black Panther, 
Captain Marvel, America Chavez, and Quasar (Avril Kincaid).
 
* The new uniforms can be purchased after the 7/14 patch data is applied
and all Uniforms will be on sale for 40% off.
* The 5 new Uniforms can be found and purchased in the Marvel Universe and the Uniform Room.
* Skills are based on the maximum stats.

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ Blue Marvel Tier-3 & Ultimate Skill

 

Blue Marvel can be advanced to Tier-3 After the patch!
Check out the power of the cosmic energy he possesses.

 

 

 

▣  America Chavez, Quasar (Avril Kincaid), and Spectrum Potential Awakening & Transcend Potential

 

Potential Awakening & Transcend Potentia will be added to America Chavez, 
Quasar (Avril Kincaid), and Spectrum through the additional patch.
 
Check out the power of Super Heroes that will be even stronger through the Potential Awakening!

 

 

 

 

 

 

 

▣ New Uniform Collection

 

A new Uniform collection has been added in celebration of the Ultimates Uniform.

 

 

▣ Other Information

 

1. Two effects of Black Panther’s Tier-3 Ultimate skill “King of the Dead” have been changed.
Before
: 15% Ignore Defense (5 Sec.)
: Ignores target’s Dodge Rate by 100%. (5 Sec.)
After
: 15% Ignore Defense (10 Sec.)
: Ignores target’s Dodge Rate by 100%. (10 Sec.)
* The issue of these two effects not being applied right after the skill has been used, but instead every time the skill is hit has been fixed. The skill duration has been extended to retain the former balance.
 
2. Below are the details for the skill effects of Black Panther <3099>’s Tier-3 Ultimate skill ‘King of the Dead’.
- The following former skill effects have been deleted.
: Increases All Attacks and Defenses by +20%, All Speed by +20%, 
  and Critical Rate by +%%, removes Incapacitation. (7 Sec.)
- Instead, the number of hits and the skill duration of 
Black Panther <3099>’s Tier-3 Ultimate skill has increased.
As a result, Agents will experience that the Ultimate skill has been improved than before.
 
3. Captain Marvel’s Ally Effect in the World Boss has been changed from “Fast Movement” to “Leadership”.
 
4. The name of the Purify effect has been changed from “Purify” to “Removes all Debuffs”.

 

▣ Game Error Fixes

 

1. ﻿The issue of Black Panther <Modern>’s Tier-3 Ultimate skill ‘King of the Dead’ not stopping the game time in some motions even when the “SFX Animation Display” option is on has been fixed.

 

We look forward to your active participation in the events held 
in celebration of the improved Ultimates and the arrival of Spectrum.

 

Thank you.
